Folio **0.1.0-rc.15** is an amd64 Linux prerelease for evaluation. This is not a stable release; the full first-release acceptance gates remain open.

## One-command installation

On a fresh Linux amd64 systemd host:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/Aoody743/Folio/releases/download/0.1.0-rc.15/install-rc15.sh | sudo bash
```

The bootstrap installer downloads the pinned archive, checks its SHA-256, and runs the packaged installer. Review `install-rc15.sh` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` before running it. The ordinary installation creates the Folio service; optional Agent capabilities require explicit flags and a root-private policy. The one-command bootstrap currently supports amd64 only.

Archive SHA-256:

```text
392458cadb7850be2653dd341a10e2f1e1935c8709640eb44ecb6e8e37d4a9a6  folio-0.1.0-rc.15-linux-amd64.tar.gz
```

The package was built from product source commit `d38e3de398d677ce39b241209658f95dcaceadfa`; the release tag includes the installer and release documentation.

## Validation and known gaps

The frozen amd64 package passed its Go race suite, `go vet`, frontend typecheck/export, package smoke checks, and independent byte-identical rebuild. RC15 also has Ubuntu PostgreSQL, task authorization, and lifecycle evidence. Debian installer, terminal, and file checks ran in a custom Debian 13 systemd guest; the official Debian cloud image could not be fetched through the available proxy.

The complete cold-install matrix has not been run on this same candidate across official Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04. Debian PostgreSQL acceptance and the full none/one/both database-selection matrix remain incomplete. G5 is **not passed**.

The cached-status p95 at concurrency 20 measured 195.219 ms against a 100 ms target; mixed read-only p95 at concurrency 20 measured 548.822 ms. These measurements used QEMU TCG with SSH forwarding and are not native-hardware capacity results. The 100 ms target has not been relaxed.
